en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a small Central European town in a hilly landscape. Foreground buildings include a manor‑like structure with a round corner tower and several multi‑storey houses with steep roofs, while to the right stands a larger fortified complex or castle on higher ground. The background features terraced hills and scattered houses along a valley road. The caption at the bottom reads "Petschau." The publisher line at lower left reads "1044 Brück & Sohn, Meissen."
